title: Vanishing above the number of sheets of an affine etale cover of a quasi-compact separated space
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Algebraic Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The proposition bounds the cohomological dimension of a quasi-coherent sheaf on a quasi-compact separated algebraic space by the number of sheets of an affine etale cover (statement lines 1332-1341). The proof feeds the cover into the alternating Cech spectral sequence, shows that the configuration schemes and their quotients are affine so that their positive cohomology vanishes even after twisting by the quasi-coherent sign sheaves, and finishes because the configuration scheme is empty beyond the fibre bound. The affineness of the configuration quotients is the substance, so the claim is H2.
